reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: retry_partial_batch (L1102-1107 in chain.rs) catches NoPeer errors from retry_columns_by_range but only logs them, then returns Ok(KeepChain), leaving the batch in Downloading state. The recovery mechanism attempt_send_awaiting_download_batches only processes batches in AwaitingDownload state, so batches stuck in Downloading are never retried. TODO comment at L1035-1039 acknowledges 'Sync manager must periodically prune stalled batches' but this mechanism doesn't exist. Attack is exploitable: attacker controls all custody peers for a column or network-partitions the node from custody peers, causing permanent sync stall. This is Fusaka-specific (PeerDAS data column sync, confirmed by comment at L955). Severity: Medium - affects single client (Lighthouse) only, estimated <33% network share, meets Medium threshold (>5% impact) per bug bounty severity definitions.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Spec mismatch: property covers SG-006 (sidecar_publishing) but vulnerability is in range sync batch retry logic, not sidecar publishing. Spec is silent on partial batch retry error handling requirements.
